in_hebrew.name: עשבי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who lives or dwells in a meadow.

in_greek.name: Ἀσβεύς
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from 'ash,' meaning ash tree, and 'beo,' meaning to swell, to grow, or to become. It could also mean 'dweller near the meadow' or 'one who lives among the ashes'.

in_latin.name: Ashbeius
in_latin.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'ascus,' meaning ash tree.
